question: How many S. marcescens strains does the ATCC hold, and how are they split between biosafety levels?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%atcc%' LIMIT 50
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%biosafety%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%BSL%' LIMIT 50
SELECT id, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=12 AND line_no BETWEEN 5 AND 30

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p12.L11'), '([0-9]+) S\. marcescens', 1) AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p12.L12'), '([0-9]+) strains', 1) AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p12.L17'), 'Only ([0-9]+) strains', 1) AS INT) AS remainder

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN id='p12.L11' THEN CAST(regexp_extract(text,'([0-9]+) S\. marcescens',1) AS INT) WHEN id='p12.L12' THEN -CAST(regexp_extract(text,'([0-9]+) strains',1) AS INT) WHEN id='p12.L17' THEN -CAST(regexp_extract(text,'Only ([0-9]+) strains',1) AS INT) END) AS remainder FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p12.L11','p12.L12','p12.L17')
